events.address: Vanderbilt Hall, Grand Central Terminal, 89 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017
events.what_it_is: A Tatcha skin-and-mind pop-up with product discovery, self-guided meditation experiences and limited special guided sessions.
events.what_is_free: The public experience, product discovery and samples are free. Special guided sessions have limited reserved capacity; self-guided meditation spots are available by reservation or first come, first served.
events.caveats: Special 10-minute guided meditation sessions have limited reserved capacity. For the broader self-guided experience, spots are available by reservation or on a first-come, first-served basis. Do not imply that an RSVP guarantees a special-session spot.
events.practical_notes: Monday Sept. 21: 9 AM–7 PM. Tuesday Sept. 22: 8 AM–7 PM. Vanderbilt Hall inside Grand Central Terminal.

events.address: Bogardus Plaza, 5 Hudson St, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: A one-day OXO Climate Week Tiny Kitchen activation with chef-curated bites, coffee, sustainability programming and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary coffee and chef-curated bites. Swivel Peelers are available while supplies last. RSVP guests are entered for a chance to receive a Rapid Brewer, limited to the first 50 guests under the published promotion terms.
events.caveats: The published RSVP language is tied to the Rapid Brewer giveaway opportunity; the source does not establish RSVP as a requirement to enter the pop-up. Giveaways are limited/while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 24, 11 AM–4 PM at Bogardus Plaza in Tribeca.

events.event_name: Light Hill: Art into Action Educational Gallery
events.what_it_is: A Climate Week educational gallery pop-up using original art, methane data and public tools to make methane pollution visible and actionable.
events.what_is_free: The week-long gallery is free and open to the public.
events.caveats: The official Climate Week calendar provides a Register Now action but also explicitly describes the exhibit as free and open to the public; it does not establish registration as a condition of admission.
events.practical_notes: Open daily Monday Sept. 21 through Sunday Sept. 27, 11 AM–6 PM.

events.event_name: Graeter's × The Paper Ice Cream Truck — Meatpacking
events.address: Washington St between Little West 12th St & Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A Peacock × Graeter's ice cream truck celebrating Season 2 of The Paper with complimentary samples of the limited-edition Black, White, and Read All Over flavor bundle.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary samples of the themed Graeter's ice cream flavors.
events.caveats: Complimentary samples are promotional and may be subject to availability. No RSVP requirement is published by Peacock.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday Sept. 22, 12–2 PM in the Meatpacking District on Washington St between Little West 12th and Gansevoort.

events.event_name: Slow Summer Reading Party with Reading Rhythms
events.address: Pier 6 Liberty Lawn, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: An outdoor social reading party with live music, an hour of reading, breakout conversations and group discussion on the Pier 6 lawn.
events.what_is_free: The event is free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Brooklyn Bridge Park says RSVPs help organizers plan but the event is free and open to the public. The park currently marks this Sept. 20 program as DELAYED, so visitors should recheck the official page/Park Alerts before traveling.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, scheduled 1–3 PM at Pier 6 Liberty Lawn. BYO blanket and book. Current park status is DELAYED.

events.address: The Hub, 115 Bowery, New York, NY 10002
events.what_it_is: A Test Thursday residency for Kem, a Vietnamese coffee pop-up, with handcrafted coffee, matcha and pandan waffles available to shop and complimentary classic Vietnamese coffee samples.
events.what_is_free: Entry is open to all with no required RSVP; samples of classic Vietnamese coffee are available for visitors to try.
events.caveats: Coffee, matcha, pandan waffles and other menu items are available for purchase; the complimentary item explicitly advertised is a sample of classic Vietnamese coffee.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 24, 11 AM–6 PM at The Hub, 115 Bowery. Open to all; no required RSVP.

events.address: The High Line — Chelsea Market Passage, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A public Chrome exhibition bringing unfinished ideas by Solange Knowles, PinkPantheress and Joe Burrow to life through physical works and interactive activations on the High Line.
events.what_is_free: The public exhibition and interactive Chrome activations are free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Current public-event sources describe the exhibit as free and open to the public with no RSVP requirement. Sept. 24 has shorter opening hours than Sept. 25–27.
events.practical_notes: Chelsea Market Passage on the High Line. Sept. 24: 2–4 PM. Sept. 25–27: 11 AM–9 PM daily.
